card.description: Made-up records from a wildlife park. Each record is one time someone checked the waterhole, and the label says if elephants visited.
card.source: Made-up (simulated data). Cut from tools/recipes/SC1-L04-waterhole-master.csv by tools/waterhole-build.js

context.potentialUses: Look for the features that go with elephants visiting the waterhole.
context.potentialMisuses: These records are made up, so they may not match what real elephants do.
